posts.text:
I did not—and do not—support the decision to postpone the budget resolution. I worked hard to get Leader Thune to agree to bring it up so we could move forward on the SAVE America Act, and I appreciate his willingness to do so.

I’m very disappointed we didn’t vote. We’ve talked enough. It’s time to stop talking and start voting.

I also voted NO to adjourn, and my NO vote is recorded in writing with the Senate clerk.

I said I’d vote to stay through August recess and get our work done. I meant it. 

I voted NO on sending the Senate home. The American people sent us here to work for them, and I’m tired of Washington acting like getting the job done is someone else’s responsibility.

posts.text:
Most Americans agree: You should have to prove you are who you say you are when you vote. 

Last night, Senate Democrats blocked a simple voter ID bill. I voted YES.

This stuff isn’t radical. It’s common sense — and it’s how we earn back the American people’s trust.
